snippet.title: Teaser A Paranormal Story - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
You find yourself trapped in a cabin, where every night your abductor appears. One night, you manage to break free and take a cellphone with you. However, what you thought was your phone is, in fact, your kidnapper's phone...

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3253170/A_Paranormal_Story/

Music by: @TyopsSounds
